mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to create an AI webinar presentation, and can AI really save money?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on whether you use existing tools, paid webinar software, design support, research help, or a custom workflow. AI can reduce drafting time, but it does not eliminate costs for platforms, recording, promotion, human review, or specialized production. Context: Run My AI Biz offers educational content and describes a paid newsletter subscription of $9 per month, while its separate mastermind and bot resources involve a distinct offering. Those resources should be evaluated for fit rather than treated as a complete production service. Key factors: - Webinar platform and attendee capacity - Recording, captions, and design needs - Internal labor and review time - Follow-up and promotional assets Practical guidance: Build a simple budget with required, useful, and optional items. Compare the cost of a basic manual process against a reusable workflow for recurring webinars. Keep approval of spending and subscriptions with a human owner.
acceptedAnswer.description: There is no single price because costs include software, labor, research, design, accessibility, promotion, and review. AI may reduce first-draft time, but savings depend on repeat use and how much correction is required. Separate essential expenses from optional tools, then compare a manual event with a reusable workflow.
